reviews.text: It. Changed.. I used to really like this app. It helped me get pregnant 4 times. Now, they want ME to PAY to have access to MY information I logged before. How is that even legal? That is my private health information I logged about my own body/cycle. I want access that, but they want me to pay for these ridiculous quarterly and yearly plans to be able to see what *I* input in the past. Pictures of my OPK strips, my symptoms, information about my body, all of that is MINE. I should have access to the information I input before *without* paying. I logged all of that when the app was free, no subscriptions. Now they’ve decided they want to charge people subscription fees to have access to information they logged in the past. Decent for Regular Cycles, Not Adaptive for Postpartum Changes. This app does a decent job tracking fertility if your cycle falls within a predictable, textbook range. It’s user-friendly and offers helpful features for logging ovulation tests, cervical mucus, BBT, and other symptoms. However, I’m five months postpartum and am currently breastfeeding, which is causing longer and less predictable cycles. Primarily later ovulation taking place around Cycle day 22-28.

Despite logging clear signs of late ovulation including a blazing positive ovulation test, a shift in cervical position, fertile-quality mucus, and a BBT rise the app won’t reanalyze or adjust its estimated ovulation date. It seems to be locked into assumptions based on “typical” cycle patterns, which makes it frustrating if your body isn’t on that schedule right now.

I still use the app for logging, but I’ve had to do my own analysis on the side. It would be much more helpful if the algorithm were flexible enough to consider the data I’m inputting, especially in non-standard situations like postpartum cycles.

I also found out that I had endometriosis through Glow and then later got diagnosed and sent to surgery for it! I am a die hard Glow user and I highly recommend this application. I urge Mother’s and Father’s alike to use this application to full capacity! This application is also great for those who are concerned about any complications, abortions, and more. I lost two children and I was helped by several women in my process…Glow is the number 1 application on the market for all things women body related! You are connected to people ALL over the world and they all share their stories, remedies, old wives tales, and much more with you. You will find groups that are not only fit to your personality but to also your culture. There’s also Doctors and nurses on this application who share educational information, and they have Q&A’s as well. Download the application, see for yourself, and trust the process. You won’t regret it, and what’s even better is that if your goal is conception, once you do, you’re able to move over to the Nurture side of the application which is created strictly for your baby’s development within the womb and even after baby is born. Much baby dust to all of you trying! And best of luck to those of you that are just wanting to find more out about your bodies! Aloha everyone! 👋🏽🌺

Too much going on. I used to love this app but have finally deleted it for good. Too many ads, too complicated. I want a simple way to track my period, not making baby supply lists or reading the news. The pop ups are non-stop.

I don’t want to subscribe to anything. I’m poor. I’ve been using this app since 2017 and it just keeps getting worse while they think they’re improving it. Sad actually.

Wish I could have kept the app. LOVED these apps it was nice that i could use the same system from conception to birth and for multiple kids! That was absolutely wonderful even if the articles were iffy and nothing new. But the fact that i no longer can safely use this app without worrying if i will be charged in my state (Wisconsin USA) because this company takes and shares all information in the system and DOES NOT require any kind of subpoena (following our legal system) to access my information! Just sad that I had to get rid of something that was so helpful and easy to use, based on something that could be fixed so easy…

Easy to use. This has become my favorite way of tracking symptoms, and it’s been two months since I purchased it. It’s easy to use, and keeps logs of everything I need.
Helped us conceive twice. The app tracked my cycle beautifully as a PCOS woman. My ovulation did come a few days early a couple times but I was able to use the app along with OPK testing to get a BFP

Use to be great. I’ve been a part of this app for a few years now. They have a fairly good period tracking portion of the app. The community section of the app use to be wonderful and a place for people to come together and for advice. Unfortunately over the past year the app has really taken a turn. I’ve witnessed people threatening physical harm and stalking users, finding out their personal information and attacking them. Not only that but there’s even been a post with child pronography in it. When asked for answers from the admin, they simply suspend you and refuse to answer your questions. I no longer feel safe using this app
Menses manager. The app is great for tracking menses, but the social network and conversations are Not appropriate for all ages.

Tries to do too much. I want a simple, easy-to-use app to track my cycle. This app includes a feed with updates in which I have no interest, various posts from other users, actual world news, and ways to create a wish list at a shop. And this is with the ad-free version which I paid for! It does track my cycle and give an “analysis,” but the amount of stuff I have to wade through to get to the features I actually use means it’s absolutely not worth it. Please make this app more simple.
Sharing. I like the app but dislike the sharing with partner options, should be more customizable. I also am sick of the giveaway options.

No longer the same.. This app has honestly went downhill. So many users on the app bash others for not understanding things. Some bash others for knowing too much. Some just bash just because & OMG don’t you dare share your personal experience they swear you don’t know what you’re talking about.

Ads Ads Ads. I recently updated the app and now all I get is Ads. I shouldn’t have to decline your premium option every time I’m doing something in the app. What a shame! Don’t use this app! Terrible!

Accurate but app is faulty. I’ve been using this app for around 3 years - since 2020! I had a pregnancy in 2021 that this app helped me track, and I’m now trying to conceive. It’s always been extremely accurate, only missing my 🩸 by a day off at times, and always 100% accurate on my ovulation day (I get ovulation cramps so I know the exact day). But last week I opened the app and it completely lost ALL MY DATA!! I’ve been logging symptoms of my cycles, potential conception dates, my past pregnancy symptoms and all for 3 yrs!!! And it’s all gone. Same account and everything but for some reason when I opened the app to log my cycle last week, the app took me thru an orientation and asked me to put my info in which it hasn’t done since I downloaded the app. And it’s not from an update either because I don’t have automatic updates on, nor have I updated it myself. This is so disappointing because I’m literally TTC right now and I’ve been tracking my ovulation symptoms on here. So disappointed!

Glow is like having a best friend!. Although I am not pregnant yet, the people I met on the GLOW forums become like my best friends! It was so comforting to be going through this grueling torture of trying to have a baby with the support of other people going through the same thing... I will forever be loyal to the GLOW app and community!
